title: Mike Santana: bringing the championship home
summary: Mike Santana pursues NXT’s Trick Williams for TNA’s world title, then fights to keep his breakthrough from being stolen. Frankie Kazarian and Nic Nemeth turn the championship into a series of betrayals and recoveries.

chapters.title: Trick escapes the three-way challenge
chapters.result: Williams retains against Santana and Joe Hendry.
chapters.context: Trick capitalizes on Santana’s offense to take the deciding fall. Santana leaves with another reason to demand a direct championship confrontation.

chapters.title: Santana defeats Trick
chapters.result: Mike Santana wins the TNA world championship.
chapters.context: With Konnan in his corner and his daughter watching, Santana survives Williams’ tactics and brings the title back to a TNA regular.

chapters.title: Kazarian cashes in after an attack
chapters.result: Frankie Kazarian takes the world title from Santana.
chapters.context: An attack leaves Santana vulnerable, allowing Kazarian to use his Call Your Shot opportunity and interrupt the new champion’s reign.

chapters.title: Santana regains the title on AMC
chapters.result: Santana defeats Kazarian to become world champion again.
chapters.context: The first AMC episode supplies the stage for Santana’s recovery from the cash-in, placing him at the center of the new television era.

chapters.title: Nemeth ends Santana’s second reign
chapters.result: Nic Nemeth defeats Santana for the world championship.
chapters.context: Ryan Nemeth’s distraction creates an opening for a trophy attack. Santana fights back but ultimately loses the title to Nic.
